description:
MaskID helps you prepare identity documents, forms, and PDFs before sharing. Import or scan a document, cover only the information you choose, review every page, and export a protected copy.

PREPARE A DOCUMENT
• Scan with the built-in document camera or import an image or PDF from Photos and Files.
• On-device text recognition can suggest details to review. You decide which areas to cover.
• Work with multi-page documents and review each page before export.

CHECK THE COPY
• Choose a redaction style and adjust each mask yourself.
• Export a protected PDF or image and review the result before sharing.
• MaskID can check an export for hidden text and common metadata. These checks cannot confirm that you selected every sensitive area; inspect the complete document and the recipient.

STORE DOCUMENTS ON YOUR TERMS
• The local library is protected with device-only encryption. The optional Vault adds Face ID or PIN protection and keeps Vault documents on this device.
• Core document protection works without a MaskID account. Optional iCloud sync uses your private CloudKit database. Optional Google Drive and Dropbox imports let you choose a file from those services.

ACCESS AND PURCHASES
New users can activate 15 calendar days of full access. This internal access period is not an App Store trial and does not start a purchase or automatic renewal. Free users from before this change receive 30 days of full access and 30 additional days to view, export, or delete their documents. After temporary access ends, a paid plan is required for commercial features. Your documents are not deleted when access expires.

MaskID Pro is available as monthly and annual subscriptions, with an optional one-time lifetime purchase. Apple shows the current price, duration, and renewal terms before you confirm. Restore eligible purchases in MaskID.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://lbernardo-dev.github.io/apps/en/case-studies/shield/privacy/
promotionalText: Cover only what you choose, review every page, and check the protected copy on your device before sharing.
whatsNew: MaskID now explains its access model before the temporary period begins. New users can activate 15 days of full access without an automatic renewal. Existing Free users receive 30 days of full access followed by 30 days to view, export, or delete their documents. Purchased access remains restorable and expiration does not delete saved documents. This update also improves navigation, accessibility, and export review. The App Store displays the current price and renewal terms before purchase.
